{{Quote|Your orders are to go to Bela Vistal and listen in on a meeting of Imperial officers. With luck, they'll let slip the location of some starships the Empire has taken from us.|[[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]], to a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:SS" />}}
A '''mission''' was carried out by the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] near the [[City/Legends|city]] of [[Bela Vistal/Legends|Bela Vistal]] on the planet [[Corellia/Legends|Corellia]] during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]].

==Prelude==
{{Quote|...and they'll be safe there. Think of it! We'll use those X-Wings in various illegal activities. Public opinion of the Rebel Alliance will plummet.|An Imperial officer|<ref name="SWG:SS" />}}
After the [[Battle of Yavin/Legends|Battle of Yavin]], the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]] had confiscated several Rebel [[T-65 X-wing starfighter/Legends|T-65 X-wing starfighters]] and stored them in an [[Imperial Base (Corellia)|Imperial Base]] in the [[Dregan's Pike]] mountain. The Empire hoped to use these X-Wings for illicit purposes, in an attempt to turn public opinion against the Rebel Alliance.<ref name="SWG:SS" />

==The mission==
{{Quote|I'm receiving word that we managed to recover almost 85% of the starships and even some starship parts.|Wedge Antilles, to a Rebel spacer|<ref name="SWG:SS" />}}
[[File:ImperialBaseCorellia.jpg|thumb|right|200px|The [[Imperial Base (Corellia)|Imperial Base]].]]
In order to retrieve the stolen X-wing starfighters, Rebel Officer [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] dispatched Rebel spacers to eavesdrop on [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] in Bela Vistal. The Rebel operatives overheard two [[Imperial officer/Legends|Imperial officers]] discussing their plan against the Rebellion. To pave the way for disrupting the Imperial project and recover the starfighters, a group of Rebel operatives set off towards the base.<ref name="SWG:SS" />

The Rebels spacers attacked the Imperial base and eliminated a number of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtrooper]] guards. They also destroyed three security terminals that controlled the automated defenses of the base. With the Imperial base defenseless, a Rebel recovery team sent by Antilles eventually managed to recover 85% of the stolen starships.<ref name="SWG:SS" />

==Behind the scenes==
The mission to Bela Vistal was a quest in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars Galaxies]]'', a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SS" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref> The quest was added to the game with the revamped "[[W:c:swg:Rebel Theme Park|Rebel Theme Park]]", released with the update dubbed "[[W:c:swg:Chapter 6 Notes for May 22 2007|Chapter 6]]," on [[May 22]], [[2007]].<ref name="SonyCite-Publish Notes – Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild">{{SonyCite|url=players/news_archive.vm?id=67250&month=052007|text=Publish Notes &ndash; Chapter 6: Masters of the Wild}}</ref>
